diagnosis: Candidate A has an unresolved Medium trade lasting 68.3 days.
At entry: price vs EMA50 -1.84%, price vs EMA200 -0.05%, EMA200 slope -0.0005%, ATR ratio 0.927, bearish candles 0.
Five one-variable hypotheses were applied to the actual problem regime (Medium) and ranked using profit, duration, drawdown, trade retention, and whether the problem trade changed.
